# `terraform stacks deployment-run show` reference

Use the `terraform stacks deployment-run show` command to show details of a deployment run.

## Usage

```shell-session
$ terraform stacks <global-stacks-flags> deployment-run show <options>
```

## Description

The `terraform stacks deployment-run show` command retrieves relevant information for a given deployment run, including its deployment steps.

You can identify the target deployment run either by providing a deployment run ID directly.

## Options

- `-deployment-run-id`: The ID of the deployment run to show.
    - Required.
    - String data type.
- `-json`: Output results in JSON format.
    - Optional.
    - Boolean flag.
    - Default is false (human-readable output).

## Examples

The following command shows details of a deployment run using the deployment run ID:

```shell-session
$ terraform stacks deployment-run show -deployment-run-id run-abc123def456
```

The following command shows details of a deployment run and outputs the result in JSON format:

```shell-session
$ terraform stacks deployment-run show -deployment-run-id run-abc123def456 -json
```

## Global flags

Refer to [Global flags reference](/terraform/cli/commands/stacks/global-flags) for information about flags you can use with all commands.
